rounds.response:
Require hard, short‑term signals before committing: a candidate vertical must generate ≥15% of new pipeline for two consecutive quarters (or inbound growth ≥50% QoQ), show win rates ≥company average (or ≥25%), median ACV ≥0.8× target, and meet unit‑economics gates (CAC payback ≤12 months and 12‑month expansion ≥20% of initial ARR).  
If those triggers hit, stand up a time‑boxed specialist pilot cell (initially 1 AE [can be fractional], 1 CSM, 0.5 SDR, 1 Partner AM and ~$150–300k GTM budget) for 6–9 months; scale to a full vertical pod only after two additional quarters of meeting the same thresholds.  
Allow a clean back‑out: if the vertical’s pipeline or unit economics fall below thresholds for two consecutive quarters, redeploy the pod and budget to FinServ or the opportunity pool without org rewiring.  
Productize “hooks” now so future verticals are cheap to spin up: build parameterized templates and dashboards, a shared canonical data model and mapping scripts, a connector SDK + adapter pattern, open embedding APIs/webhooks, and templated onboarding flows/instrumentation for expansion signals.  
Operationalize with quarterly Finance+GTM reviews, a 12‑month flex budget tranche, and a one‑page decision playbook that lists the triggers, pilot staffing, budget floors, and rollback rules to ensure disciplined, fast pivots.

Narrative: pursue a FinServ beachhead to drive repeatable subscription ARR via productized templates, key data/CRM/core‑system integrations and embeddable analytics, seed Healthcare as a time‑boxed follow‑on, and keep a small opportunity pool (budget + 2–3 FTEs) ready to spin up a third vertical if signals meet strict thresholds—all underpinned by simplified Self‑Serve + Enterprise packaging and focus KPIs (ARR, NRR, trial→paid, CAC payback).  
Commercial evolution (practical): Year‑1 build core FinServ motion (2–4 FinServ AEs, 2 CSMs, SDR+AE mid‑market, 1 Partner AM) to prove land‑and‑expand; Year‑2 scale FinServ (+~4 AEs, +3 CSMs), formalize Partner Sales Managers and roll a lean Healthcare specialist cell (1 AE, 1 CSM) as a probe; Year‑3 replicate pods or pivot resources to a third vertical depending on signals—target partner‑sourced bookings ≥15% by end of Year‑2 and 20–30% by Year‑3.  
Product/packaging sequencing: Year‑1 ship 3 FinServ templates, Snowflake + Salesforce + one core‑banking connector, embeddable SDK v1, and improved onboarding; Year‑2 add Redshift/BigQuery and additional core adapters, productize more FinServ workflows and a lightweight EHR/HIPAA kit; Year‑3 launch marketplace/OEM embedding, richer APIs and outcome‑based pilots once FinServ repeatability is proven.  
Third‑vertical entry rules and pilot design: require ≥15% of new pipeline for two consecutive quarters (or inbound ≥50% QoQ), win rates ≥company avg (or ≥25%), median ACV ≥0.8× target, CAC payback ≤12 months and 12‑month expansion ≥20% before standing up a time‑boxed pilot (1 fractional AE, 1 CSM, 0.5 SDR, 1 Partner AM, $150–300k for 6–9 months); scale to a full pod only after two further quarters of meeting thresholds.  
Governance and go/no‑go gates: quarterly Finance+GTM reviews on unit‑economics dashboards, release hires and partner investments in tranches tied to pilot KPIs (trial→paid lift and NRR/CAC payback), and retain a 12‑month flex budget and a one‑page reallocation playbook to accelerate, pause or pivot within a single quarter.
